note: Decision 6a: the rating lives in 3..5 exactly as the original — a fresh hotel is 3 stars and cannot fall below 3; neglect is punished by pests and blocked income, not by the rating. Tiers 1 and 2 are unreachable by construction (thresholds two/three are 0 and tier 3 has no minimums) and exist only because the schema requires five rows; they clone tier 3. Decision 1a: dailyBonusCoins is the money-bag value, 400..430 by stars, ending at 430 at five stars.

score.note: Decision 7a: only what the original documented moves the rating — decor fill (via room quality), amenity breadth, and cleanliness. Satisfaction and staff service carry zero weight. four=55 / five=80 are provisional bands calibrated so the tier minimums (12 rooms + 3 amenities, 20 rooms + 6 amenities) remain the binding gates.
